additional_info.body:
Hello Riccardo,
what is the actual state of this issue, we didnt get a reply from last Remote support Session?
From what i understand, there is no logical connection between autocharge and any kind of hardware. It simply checks the EVCCID, and if it's there for authorization, it will start. So if parallel charging works without autocharge then there must be something wrongly configured
Thank you.
With best regards,
Semih Sentürk
eMobility Tech Support Team
